# Phosphor Icons provenance

SableOS R9 uses selected glyph geometry from Phosphor Icons as the basis for
its first-party application icon system.

- repository: https://github.com/phosphor-icons/core
- pinned commit: `2b75f3ad12b420c9504ef05df8d2564a28f8500e`
- upstream license: MIT
- upstream copyright: Copyright (c) 2023 Phosphor Icons

Only selected paths are adapted. Sable supplies the surrounding tonal
background, optical sizing, stable per-app accent rail and Android resource
composition. No runtime icon-library dependency or network fetch is used.
